answers.core: Because the import logic of textures is in core, and having to re-implement and maintain a 90%-working copy is not robust.
answers.workaround: It can mostly be worked around, but as you saw, it's really not a few lines of code. Otherwise people keep hardcoding one path and don't even implement (or know about?) the other features Godot is supposed to support.

title: Allow to extend existing texture importers
